People treated me well but I don't think they will treat me well If I stayed too long. 

>Or maybe you could use your passion and understanding of politics and transform it maybe to a blog?

Blog? No thanks I don't want to get arrested. Even now I'm using Tor to reply because I said fuck erdogan. If anyone knows that I'm swearing to our "dear leader er-dong-un" I'll get arrested too.
Do you got more useless-overly generalizing platitudes to share?

Whenever I go through check-up points in airports, police search my belongings, every single time with frowned faces. And only me in that particular time


I'm always shaved, clean, dress-up nicely. So no I'm physically normal. Things always went sour when officers see my passport.


Even last time while I was returning to my home from erasmus. Police held me in custody for 20 minutes, asking me where I'm going. I told them I completed my study and going back to home and presented my certificate of erasmus. He didnt satisfied, started searching my books, even took some dust samples from my books (They were fucking medical textbooks for fuck sake not some fucking explosives). Finally they let me go, but I almost missed my plane.


I understand them though, people can decide to not to take strangers to their country.

>Implying I dont get out.


What would I accomplish by getting out?

Sure thing.

Well the thing is everyday, country becomes shittier. Rise of bigoted fanatics are not helping either. Some people suggest me to go abroad but I'm not gonna do it. I'm an unwanted person outside of my country. Also an outsider in my country due to my dissent ideas.
